RAM: 4GB 
OC: Windows 10.

notes.title: Update V2
notes.content:
Most of the errors in the game has been fixed,

[list]
[*]CRASH at entering the house has been fixed.
[*]Skybox changed to a higher quality.
[*]All source files were processed by hand.
[*]Changed first level of the game.
[*]Changed scripts interaction.
[*]Changed loading screens.
[*]Rebuilt archive Mapbank.
[*]Images are now displayed in the center.
[*]Change the resolution (default 1920x1080)
[*]Improved optimization of games for about 35-40% UP
[/list]

notes.title: Please do not use ShadowPlay or other programs for video recording!
notes.content:
The game can give a critical error!
If you have problems in the game and "CRASH at entering the house", and you cann't load level 2, please use the "Сhapters" in the game menu for a stable load level.
